items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for public beta or go-live. Keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only. Evidence shows Woot documents API access but does not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; current public terms point against those uses. Compliance is technical baseline only, not certification. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and counsel gates remain incomplete. No go-live proposal is supported. Do not send rights outreach or change the private gate without owner authorization and human counsel review.

Launch-readiness data-use review completed. Woot API deal and price-history data: BLOCKED; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/derivatives/display/cache/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, image/price/trademark, affiliate and advertising terms. Smallest next action: assemble the existing rights packet for owner-authorized human-counsel review; do not send outreach. User alert rules and sync results: EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention/deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the read-only data-flow and retention table from existing repository/configuration evidence. GA4 analytics: EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing deployed consent and withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent/configuration evidence without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only operator/vendor inventory and flag counsel-required gaps. No data-use item is clear enough for public launch.

Fleet compliance and growth disposition: ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. However, do not admit new work this cycle because capacity is 10/10 and the preserved allthingsmasonic.com CTA candidate remains gated by existing repair, validation, measurement, compliance, security, owner, and rollback checks. Affiliate disclosure and destination must remain intact; aggregate affiliate income remains unattributed and supports no revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claim.
